# Confirm home status undo expires after its recovery window

## What & Why
The home page now offers a short-lived undo after marking an opportunity applied. A regression test should confirm the action disappears after the recovery window so stale status changes cannot be reversed unexpectedly.

## Done looks like
- The browser test advances time beyond the home undo window after Mark applied
- The undo notice and action are no longer available
- The applied status remains persisted after reload
